notes_for_editor: Thin record. Sources: a 1948 NGS station description reproduced on a volunteer site (not read from NGS itself), the FFLA list (Standing), an undated Texas Escapes travel page, and the TSHA community entry. No build date, staffing, fire history or access found, and no photo with a usable licence found. The O'Quinn part of the name is unexplained in every source read. An Angelina County PDF (angelinacounty.net/files/pdf/rfc.pdf) describes a proposed county radio tower on Central ISD land just off US 69 near O'Quinn Road; it does not say it is this lookout's site, so it is not used. The record's height (33.5 m) matches the survey's 110 feet. TSHA (cite 2) puts the community eight miles northwest of Lufkin on US 69, against the survey's ten miles airline; the story gives both figures and does not choose between them. Editor may want the Texas Forest Service or a local history source for the build year and the name origin.
